Because a click-only probe cannot observe focus, field focus, checkbox toggles in collapsed panels, or slider transforms, every "dead" candidate was re-adjudicated with targeted verification probes (real CDP mouse clicks, typing, tile/transform/checked/type inspection); adjudications are recorded per element and summarised in adjudicationProbes.
